## Complete this before the workshop

### 1. Confirm software

State exact minimum versions and provide one verification command per dependency.

```bash
quarto --version
R --version
```

### 2. Install packages

Use a single copyable block and pin versions when reproducibility requires it.

### 3. Download example data

Provide checksums for larger or frequently mirrored files.

### 4. Run the preflight check

Give participants a 30-second test that confirms the environment works.

### 5. Report problems

Specify what diagnostic output to include and where to ask for help.
